remaining_cautions.evidence_context: Table 1 gives the same 15-residue letter sequence for Amp1L and Amp1EP peptides, while footnotes and synthesis text define C-terminal amidation and single isopeptide-bond positions. Modified peptides are therefore not normalized to unmodified source_verified linear sequences.

DBAASP provides exact hRBC/RAW/HEK 50% toxicity thresholds for modified peptides, but local source text and captions support only selected qualitative or percentage-reduction toxicity values. Exact database thresholds remain source_conflict rather than source_verified.
